verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an ML cloud platform, since a vendor could ship an on-prem or self-managed edition. The evidence only describes hosted Paperspace services (Machines, Notebooks, Deployments, Workflows) run in Paperspace datacenters. Root SSH access to rented VMs and the API/CLI let users control hosted resources, but they do not let users run Paperspace itself on their own infrastructure, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
